confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and building. Drink anchors are set from the local beer price relationship and are less certain. The FX value comes from a search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page to confirm the figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on East Asian high-cost hubs such as Singapore, Tokyo and Taipei, adjusted for Hong Kong's high rents, its dining and bar prices, and the HKD peg to USD (about 7.8 HKD per USD). Cocktail and wine prices are set relative to the estimated beer price.
